**Domain:** Arms, security, private military, mercenary trade

**Arms division:** **Iron Writ Arms (IW)** — plain military workhorses sold to anyone with a contract. IW hates that Nyx copies its designs. Signature: IW Journeyman, IW Bastion, IW Barrage-12, IW Absolution.
